results.description: 718 Category 1 incidents, meaning contributing to or resulting in permanent harm or death, were logged in 2026

results.title: KNRUHS reopens BHMS Management Quota applications for 2026-27
results.description: Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences has reopened online applications for BHMS Management Quota Category B and C/NRI admissions in Telangana private homoeopathic colleges for 2026-27. Registration closes at 4 pm Monday.
